verdict.rationale: macOS documents user automation through Shortcuts ([macos-docs-19]). It also has some fixed-function background behaviors: Safari Notify Me monitors pages for changes and alerts you ([macos-docs-34]), the Passwords app updates weak passwords on your behalf ([macos-docs-35]), and Siri AI takes actions in apps ([macos-docs-28]). However, the Shortcuts evidence is a single headline, and nothing shows user-defined automations being scheduled or triggered to run unattended in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or event-triggered user-built automations, documentation that Shortcuts or other tools run unattended in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
